payments.sectionHelp: How renters pay you, and where the money goes.
payments.title: Payment processor
payments.description: Renters pay into your own Stripe account and Stripe pays out to your bank. Refunds, disputes and payouts are managed in your Stripe Dashboard.
payments.summary: Connect a Stripe account to take card payments and deposits from renters.

notice.unavailable: Stripe isn't configured on the server yet, so an account can't be connected. Add the Stripe keys to the API environment to switch this on.
notice.needsInfo: Stripe needs a few more details before it can turn on payments and payouts.
notice.pastDue: A deadline for some of Stripe's details has passed, so payments or payouts may be paused. Finish setup to restore them.
notice.inReview: Stripe is reviewing your details. Check back here, or use Check status.
notice.rejected: Stripe couldn't approve this account. Your Stripe Dashboard or Stripe support can tell you why.
notice.disconnected: Payments are off. Your Stripe account, balance and payouts are untouched; reconnect to take payments through it again.

payments.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can connect or finish setting up Stripe.

confirmDisconnect.title: Disconnect Stripe?
confirmDisconnect.description:
Veltrio will stop taking payments through this Stripe account.

The account stays yours, with its balance and payouts, and you can reconnect it at any time.

confirmNewAccount.title: Set up a different Stripe account?
confirmNewAccount.description:
You'll go to Stripe to set up a new account for Veltrio.

Your current account stays yours, with its balance and payouts, but Veltrio won't be able to reconnect it afterwards.
